introduce:
Lie down on your back, and put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Then lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.
name: LEG RAISES

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Raise up your legs faster and put them down slower.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don't pull your shoulders up off the floor.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too hard, put a little bend in your knees.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
This exercise targets your lower abdominals.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens the abdomen, back and shoulders.
name: PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your lower back.
Too hard? Lower your knees on the mat with your ankles crossed in the air.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
It's not right if your shoulders or lower back are sore.
This exercise works your core.
This exercise is good for your spine.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards.\n\nThen hold your hands together and twist from side to side.
name: RUSSIAN TWIST

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Don't move your legs when twisting.
Breathe naturally.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your obliques.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your hands behind your ears. Raise your knees and close your right elbow toward your left knee, then close your left elbow toward your right knee. Repeat the exercise.
name: BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominals.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
If you can see your elbows, please open your chest.
Exhale when lifting your body and inhale when lowering.
You should feel your abs burning.
You shouldn't feel too much strain in your neck.

introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms stretched forward, then lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes. Return to the start position and do the next rep. 

This works the thighs, hips buttocks, quads, hamstrings and lower body.
name: SQUATS

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your glutes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If it's too easy for you, go lower for a deep squat.
If you feel it's too hard, widen your feet to get more balance.
This works on all the muscles of your lower body.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

introduce: Start in the push-up position. Then go down for a push-up and as you come up, rotate your upper body and extend your right arm upwards. \n\nRepeat the exercise with the other arm. It\'s a great exercise for the chest, shoulders, arms and core.
name: PUSH-UP & ROTATION

tips.text: Prepare a mat first.
Your hands should be directly under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it easier, lower your knees on the floor.
If your abdominals are shivering, don't worry, it works.
Your shoulders should not feel too much stress.
This exercise really works on all of your upper body muscles.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. 

Then jump to the right. As you jump, bring your left foot behind you and your left arm in front of you. 

Then jump to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: SKATER JUMP

tips.text: Keep your back flat and your core tight.
Keep your shoulders back.
Don't lean your body forward too much.
Exhale when you jump, and inhale when you land.
You should feel your legs and butt burning.
This exercise can get your heart rate up.
This exercise is good for your cardiovascular system.
This exercise is great for your legs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.
name: FLUTTER KICKS

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead.\n\nAlternately lift your opposite arm and leg.
name: SWIMMER AND SUPERMAN

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too easy, raise both your legs and arms at the same time.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees slightly bent. 

Lift your arms in front of you with your elbows bent. 

Twist your upper body to the left and then the right.
name: TRUNK ROTATION

tips.text: Please adjust your cadence according to your preferences.
Exhale deeply as you twist to the side.
Inhale as you twist back to the center.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows directly under your shoulders.

 Lift your left leg up at a 45 degree angle while reaching your right arm over to your left side.

 Then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat several times, and then switch to the other side.
name: RECLINED OBLIQUE TWIST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do this slowly to get better results.
Please keep your legs straight.
If you feel the exercise is too hard, you can put your legs on the floor.
If you feel the exercise is too easy, you can lift both legs.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your obliques, abs and thighs.

introduce:
Lie on your right side. Put your right elbow directly under your shoulders and put your left hand on your waist. Place your left leg on your right leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.
name: SIDE BRIDGES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

introduce:
Lie on your left side. Put your left elbow directly under your shoulders and put your right hand on your waist. Place your right leg on your left leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.
name: SIDE BRIDGES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your right foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your left leg is fully extended and you can feel your left calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your left foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your right leg is fully extended and you can feel your right calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs stretched and your hands underneath your hips. 

Lift your knees until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor. Straighten your legs and lift your hips up off the floor. 

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: REVERSE CRUNCHES WITH LEG RAISED

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward, then bring your feet back and jump up. Repeat the exercise.
name: MODIFIED BURPEES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.
